name: smart_ev_teacher_e2e_v4
description: Smart EV full E2E teacher verification v4. Ch1: V2 Kripke model (28 states, 47 transitions, 16 CTL properties). Ch2: 6 C functions â€” 2 safe baselines + 4 bug-injected probes (buffer-overflow, memory-leak, double-free, use-after-free). Ch3: 12 Z3 arithmetic checks covering SOC/TEMP/POWER/CHARGING domains with SAT/UNSAT pairs and overflow probes using production constants. Ch4: 3 Python functions â€” 2 divide (CWE-369) + 1 magic_value (CWE-798 concolic). Formal and SMT artifacts are grounded in Smart EV requirements and production constants. Ch2/Ch4 generated artifacts are capability probes linked to Smart EV scenarios and are not production-equivalent implementations.

requirements.text: Vehicle authentication may succeed only when the vehicle is connected and the token is valid.
When a vehicle disconnects from the station, authentication must be cleared.
Vehicle SOC must remain between 0% and 100%.
A vehicle with SOC at 100% must not continue receiving charging power.
When battery temperature reaches or exceeds 60 C, charging must stop.
A port may enter CHARGING only when a valid vehicle is connected.
At any time, one charging port may be linked to at most one vehicle.
A faulted port must not deliver charging power.
Charging may start only when the vehicle is connected, authenticated, battery and temperature are safe, the port is ready, and no emergency or fault is active.
Charging requires the complete safety gate to remain valid.
Emergency or fault conditions must stop charging and force charging power to zero.

arithmetic_checks.condition: soc >= 0 and soc <= 100 and (soc < 0 or soc > 100)

arithmetic_checks.condition: soc_current >= 0 and soc_current <= 100 and soc_delta >= 0 and soc_delta <= 100

arithmetic_checks.name: gd12_temp_safe_range_sat
arithmetic_checks.condition: offset >= 0 and offset <= 79 and temperature == offset and temperature < 60

arithmetic_checks.name: gd12_power_cap_not_exceeded
arithmetic_checks.condition: power_port1 >= 0 and power_port1 <= 22 and power_port2 >= 0 and power_port2 <= 22 and power_port3 >= 0 and power_port3 <= 22 and power_port4 >= 0 and power_port4 <= 22 and power_port5 >= 0 and power_port5 <= 22

test_cases.title: Ch3 Z3: SOC domain contract â€” 5 SMT checks
test_cases.preconditions: SOC_MIN=0, SOC_MAX=100 from src/core/hang_so.h. Conditions use integer encoding of float bounds.
steps: gd12_soc_valid_domain_sat: condition 'soc>=0 and soc<=100' -> SAT (e.g. soc=4).
gd12_soc_violation_contradiction_unsat: contradiction -> UNSAT.
gd12_soc_update_no_overflow: bounded update -> SAT, overflow_expr sum<=200 no CWE-190.
gd12_soc_full_threshold_sat: soc>=100 -> SAT (soc=100).
gd12_soc_charging_blocked_when_full: soc>=100 and charging=0 -> SAT.
test_cases.expected_result: SAT: gd12_soc_valid_domain_sat, gd12_soc_update_no_overflow, gd12_soc_full_threshold_sat, gd12_soc_charging_blocked_when_full. UNSAT: gd12_soc_violation_contradiction_unsat. No CWE-190 from gd12_soc_update_no_overflow (bounded by [0,100]).

test_cases.title: Ch3 Z3: Temperature domain contract â€” 4 SMT checks
test_cases.preconditions: NHIET_DO_TOI_DA=60 (inclusive, >=). Negative lower bound -20 encoded via offset trick to avoid parser UnaryOp error.
steps: gd12_temp_overheat_threshold_sat: temperature>=60 -> SAT (temperature=60).
gd12_temp_overheat_contradiction_unsat: >=60 and <60 -> UNSAT.
gd12_temp_safe_range_sat: offset [0,79] with temperature<60 -> SAT.
gd12_temp_charging_blocked_when_overheat: temp>=60 and charging=0 -> SAT.
test_cases.expected_result: SAT: overheat_threshold, safe_range, charging_blocked. UNSAT: contradiction. All 4 checks pass.

test_cases.title: Ch3 Z3: Power and station capacity contract â€” 3 SMT checks
test_cases.preconditions: CONG_SUAT_CONG_TOI_DA=22kW, SO_CONG_SAC=5, CONG_SUAT_TRAM_TOI_DA=100kW. Max total 5x22=110kW. int32 overflow not possible at this scale.
steps: gd12_power_cap_not_exceeded: 5 ports each [0,22] -> SAT, overflow_expr<=110, no CWE-190.

gd12_charging_rate_positive_time: energy_wh in [0,79200] and time_seconds>0 -> SAT.
test_cases.expected_result: All 3 SAT. No int32 overflow within production bounds. Power cap and emergency semantics confirmed satisfiable.

test_cases.title: Ch4 black-box fuzz: division-by-zero on charging rate and token ratio
test_cases.preconditions: ev_charging_power_ratio and ev_token_validation_ratio are TOOL-CAPABILITY ARTIFACTS representing the arithmetic structure of real Smart EV computations. Production uses float arithmetic; probe uses Python integer divide for fuzzing.
steps: Run blackbox_fuzz on ev_charging_power_ratio with arg_types=['int','int'].
Expect crashes when session_time_seconds=0 (ZeroDivisionError).
Run blackbox_fuzz on ev_token_validation_ratio with arg_types=['int','int'].
Expect crashes when tokens_active=0.
Confirm CWE-369 (Divide by Zero) classified for both.
Document as TOOL_CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE / PROBE_ONLY; production uses guard time_seconds>0.
test_cases.expected_result: Both functions crash with ZeroDivisionError when denominator=0. CWE-369 classified as PROBE_ONLY. Demonstrates Ch4 pipeline runs end-to-end; not production REQ evidence.

test_cases.title: Ch4 concolic fuzz: firmware unlock gate with Z3-guided input synthesis
test_cases.preconditions: ev_firmware_unlock_gate uses magic_values=[4721, 9033]. Concolic fuzzer uses Z3 symbolic execution to find inputs that trigger the raise. This probes the risk of hardcoded credentials in emergency override paths.
steps: Run concolic_fuzz on ev_firmware_unlock_gate.
Z3 solver derives unlock_code_a=4721, unlock_code_b=9033.

Document as TOOL_CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE / PROBE_ONLY; production should use cryptographic auth.
test_cases.expected_result: Concolic fuzzer finds crash_input={unlock_code_a:4721, unlock_code_b:9033}. CWE-798 finding generated as PROBE_ONLY, not a confirmed production defect.

test_cases.title: Model integrity and reachability audit
test_cases.preconditions: Baseline state_machine with initial DISCONNECTED.
steps: Check uniqueness of state IDs and consistency between states and labeling keys.
Check all transition endpoints and that every declared state has an outgoing edge.
Compute reachable states from DISCONNECTED and list unreachable states.
Check whether every violation witness is reachable; if not, require separate negative-control models.
test_cases.expected_result: No dangling endpoints or deadlocks. Unreachable states must be reported; baseline AG results must not be treated as sufficient evidence without negative controls.

test_cases.title: CTL liveness: AF(safe) must expose the current non-progress loop
test_cases.preconditions: Baseline model has self-loops at SOC_FULL, OVERHEAT, PORT_FAULT, EMERGENCY and DISCONNECTING; these states are not labeled safe.
steps: Evaluate AF(safe) using standard CTL semantics.
Inspect the counterexample path and identify a non-safe self-loop.
After a future model fix, rerun and require AF(safe) to hold only if the intended requirement truly guarantees eventual safe state on every path.
test_cases.expected_result: Current model is expected to violate AF(safe); record this as a specification/model defect, not as a checker failure.

test_cases.title: SMT boundary: station total power must not exceed 100 kW
test_cases.preconditions: Each of 5 ports has maximum 22 kW, but station maximum is 100 kW.
steps: Solve for a valid boundary where total power equals 100 kW.
Solve for a violating assignment where every port is <=22 kW but total power is 101..110 kW.
Check that the safety contract makes the violating assignment UNSAT.
test_cases.expected_result: Total=100 kW is SAT; total>100 kW is UNSAT under the corrected condition. A model that checks only per-port <=22 kW is incomplete.

test_cases.title: SMT boundary: battery temperature range -20..60 C
test_cases.preconditions: NHIET_DO_TOI_THIEU=-20 and NHIET_DO_TOI_DA=60.
steps: Use offset in [0,79] and temperature=offset-20 to represent -20..59 C.
Check temperatures -20, -1, 0, 59, 60, and 61 C.
Confirm threshold >=60 is the overheat condition.
test_cases.expected_result: The safe range encoding includes -20..59 C; 60 C and above trigger overheat. The original offset==temperature expression did not encode the documented -20 C lower bound.

review_notes.purpose: Expanded verification plan and explicit audit findings; this field is supplemental and does not replace executable evidence.
important_limitations: This file defines verification inputs and expected outcomes; adding a test case does not mean the test has already been executed.
The baseline model contains unreachable violation-witness states; safety AG results must be interpreted alongside separate negative-control models.
AF(safe) is expected to be violated under standard CTL semantics because some non-safe states have self-loops.
The arithmetic conditions for temperature range and total station power were corrected to match the documented production constants.
Ch2 and Ch4 generated examples remain TOOL_CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE / PROBE_ONLY, not production-equivalent code or proof of production defects.

audit_findings.finding: AF(safe) conflicts with self-loops on non-safe transient states.
audit_findings.expected_action: Treat the formula as an expected counterexample until the model's progress semantics are corrected.

audit_findings.finding: Violation-witness states are unreachable from DISCONNECTED in the baseline model.
audit_findings.expected_action: Run independent negative-control models and retain counterexamples; do not rely on vacuous AG truth.

audit_findings.finding: Per-port limits alone permit up to 110 kW, while station maximum is 100 kW.
audit_findings.expected_action: Include sum(power_port1..power_port5) <= 100 in the station power constraint.

audit_findings.finding: Temperature offset condition did not represent the documented -20 C lower bound.
audit_findings.expected_action: Encode temperature = offset - 20 for offset in [0,79].

audit_findings.finding: energy_wh + time_seconds is dimensionally invalid as an overflow expression.
audit_findings.expected_action: Remove the mixed-unit overflow expression; test numerator/denominator bounds separately.
